summary: OpenTable booking prefers an explicitly configured signed-in Chrome attachment, checks only required booking-form agreements, and reports sanitized typed failures when the final form does not navigate.
reason: Akamai blocks the Surf make-reservation write even when browser reads work, and OpenTable can render a transient signed-out venue shell or omit native required metadata from restaurant-terms checkboxes. Regeneration must retain the bounded venue refresh, form-scoped agreement handling, and typed attach diagnostics without selecting optional marketing controls or logging browser credentials.
validated_outcome: Live attach checked the required restaurant-terms agreement, confirmed Brewery Bhavana for party 2 at 2026-07-11 20:30, and the signed-in dining dashboard showed the venue, date, and time; no confirmation number was visible.
